richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tezpur

c: Tezpur sits on the north bank of the Brahmaputra and has a large army presence, a central university and tea gardens around it. Each of these runs its own campus with open ground and residents who exercise daily. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tezpur for these campuses and for municipal parks and schools. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 2,190 km away, and we send every order by road.

Assam's monsoon is long and heavy, and Tezpur stays humid most of the year. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for that. Because of the distance, we agree on machines, layout and quote before manufacture, so the order arrives complete. Installation is by our team or a dealer in the northeast.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to defence and university campuses?
items.a: We supply campuses of all kinds across India. Share the site size, users and any purchase requirements, and we will send machine details, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: How is a project in Assam handled from Maharashtra?
items.a: We finalise machines, layout and quote first. After approval we manufacture in Vasai, dispatch by road and install through our team or a dealer in the northeast.

items.q: Is rubber flooring needed under a Cross Fit frame?
items.a: We recommend it, because users hang and drop from the bars. We supply rubber flooring along with the equipment. It also protects the ground under the frame from wear.
